name: roadkeep-site
description: The public site for roadkeep. The copy lives in one module and the sections only render it.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-server && node scripts/prerender.mjs && npm run build:docs
